## 📄 Tool: get_internal_page
Mengambil isi utuh + outline satu halaman internal dari tabel `seo_pages` (hasil ingestion). URL dicocokkan tanpa peduli http/https, www, atau garis miring di akhir.

parameters.query:
SELECT url, title, meta_description, word_count, markdown,
       to_char(modified_gmt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS modified_gmt, to_char(indexed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS indexed_at
FROM seo_pages
WHERE rtrim(regexp_replace(url, '^https?://(www\.)?', ''), '/')
    = rtrim(regexp_replace(trim($1), '^https?://(www\.)?', ''), '/')
LIMIT 1;
